title: Client intake answers (one file per run)
description: C1 contract. Written by shared-utils/client_intake/engine.py, read by Skill 49 launch and legacy intake, Skill 71 write_intake (--answers-file) and Skill 83. Harness-neutral: claude-nine, Claude Code and OpenClaw all write and resume this same file. The F16 answer contract (answer_contract in engine.py) is derived from this file: design decision state, brand provenance, approved spend ceiling, plan revision and approval binding. answers.provenance.schema.json describes that block.

page_kind.description: Skill 71 page runs: an opt-in landing page is long-form only.

estimate_of.description: last computed count of applicable questions; a changed estimate is explained to the client

mode_source.description: explicit_request when the client named the mode; routing otherwise

brand_version.description: moves with every recorded brand answer; binds a producer's brand file to the answers it was made from

plan_revision.description: the plan revision this file is currently bound to

plan_hash.description: the exact plan subject an approval binds to

plan_approval_ref.description: the approval record that accepted this plan hash and revision

approval_subject.description: what the approval was given for; plan_binding reports stale when it no longer matches plan_hash/plan_revision

source_message_ref.description: The client message (in the transcript store) a never-default commercial answer (price, packages, deliverables, funnel_shape, entitlement) was taken from. Required when such an answer is provided.

confirmation_ref.description: The client message that said yes to the echoed price.

pending.description: What the last help message offered (colors read, feel words, recommendation), so the next reply can finish it. Dropped when the answer is recorded.

accepted_proposal.description: true when the client accepted a suggestion we made; the decision state is accepted_recommendation, never a supplied fact

proposal_artifact.description: the artifact an accepted proposal produced, kept as its provenance

unresolved_capability.description: a capability the run does not have, so an accepted proposal stays unresolved by name

accepted.description: written by revision.py's one acceptance transition: the approval record, the prior state and provenance, and the hashes it binds

reconciled.description: what a revision removed and why; the prior value, state and provenance are kept

proposals.description: open proposals, keyed by question id: an artifact or action the client has not accepted yet. Never an answer.

packages_partial.description: packages accumulated one turn at a time before the answer is complete
